Founded in 2011 by 100 fishing families of Yeosu, YEOSU SAEGOMAK Co., Ltd. has led the 
industry as Korea's first company specializing in parboiled ark clam cockles.
Cockles raised in the pristine waters of Jeollanam-do are more than seafood. They are 
Korea's finest seafood ingredient — the product of clean seas, honest producers, and 
rigorous quality control.
Building on a network of more than 400 domestic accounts, we now bring the taste and 
care of the sea to global markets through our three brands: Umjine Pojangmacha, 
Chilsan Marinated Crab, and Yeosu Olim. With healthy, safe, and delicious seafood, we

C E O  G R E E T I N G
“To enrich people's lives through honest food”
YEOSU SAEGOMAK was founded with some 100 fishing families as 
shareholders. As an industry leader, we put safe, high-quality food first at 
every stage — from the receiving of fresh and parboiled shellfish such as ark 
clam cockles and ark shells through to the shipment of finished products.
Through strict raw-material selection and rigorous hygiene and quality 
management systems, we have earned Korea's general HACCP certification 
and the international FSSC 22000 food safety certification, and are 
recognized at home and abroad as a company with world-class food safety 
technology.
Thinking from the customer's perspective, we established our Food R&D 
Center for systematic research and development. From primary processed 
foods to a premium seafood HMR (home meal replacement) lineup, our 
diverse product portfolio offers customers new experiences and sets 
differentiated trends in the food industry.
Driven by a culture of continuous, market-leading innovation, we are 
expanding into overseas markets and a broader range of processed seafood, 
and we will realize our vision of growing into a comprehensive seafood 
processing company and entering the KOSDAQ market.
We are deeply grateful for the trust our customers place in YEOSU SAEGOMAK 
Co., Ltd. Guided by our mission — “to enrich people's lives through honest 
food” — every member of our team will always give their very best.

How we collect, use, and protect your personal information
YEOSU SAEGOMAK Co., Ltd. (the “Company”) complies with the Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA) of Korea 
and other applicable laws, and establishes and discloses this Privacy Policy as follows to safely protect the personal 
information of data subjects and to handle related grievances promptly and smoothly.
Article 1 (Personal Information Collected and Collection Methods)
The Company collects the following personal information when inquiries are submitted through the website (buyer 
inquiries, domestic trade inquiries, OEM/ODM inquiries, and export voucher inquiries).
• Required items: company (affiliation), name, phone number, email address, and inquiry details
• Automatically collected items: IP address (to prevent spam and misuse)
Collection method: website inquiry forms
Article 2 (Purposes of Processing Personal Information)
The Company processes the collected personal information only for the following purposes. If any purpose changes, 
the Company will take necessary measures, such as obtaining separate consent, in accordance with applicable laws.
• Receiving inquiries, responding to consultations, and replying with handling results
• Preventing spam and fraudulent use and ensuring service stability
Article 3 (Retention and Use Period of Personal Information)
The Company retains records of inquiry receipt and handling for three (3) years, applying mutatis mutandis the Act 
on the Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce, etc. of Korea, and destroys them without delay thereafter 
(records on the handling of consumer complaints or disputes: 3 years).
Article 4 (Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties)
The Company does not provide personal information of data subjects to third parties, except where the data subject 
has given prior consent or where otherwise specifically provided by law.
Article 5 (Outsourcing of Personal Information Processing)
The Company does not currently outsource any personal information processing related to inquiry handling. Should 
any outsourcing occur in the future, the Company will disclose the outsourcee and the scope of the outsourced work 
through this policy without delay.
Article 6 (Destruction Procedures and Methods)
The Company destroys personal information without delay once the retention period has elapsed or the purpose of 
processing has been achieved.
• Electronic files: permanently deleted in a manner that prevents recovery or restoration
• Paper documents: shredded or incinerated
Article 7 (Rights of Data Subjects and How to Exercise Them)
Data subjects may at any time request the Company to allow access to, correct, delete, or suspend the processing of 
their personal information. Such requests may be made in writing, by phone, or by email to the privacy officer under 
Article 8, and the Company will take action without delay.

personal information processing and to handle inquiries, complaints, and remedies of data subjects regarding
